# Global Cyber Associates

> Global Cyber Associates (GCA) is a cybersecurity services firm for startups and
> MSMEs, delivering VAPT, ISO 27001 & SOC 2 compliance support, 24/7 SOC monitoring,
> and security training. GCA also builds VisuN AI, a workforce visibility and
> insider-risk monitoring platform.

GCA operates from Chennai, India (Besant Nagar) and has a U.S. presence in Charlotte,
North Carolina and Edison, New Jersey. Primary contact: info@globalcyberassociates.com,
+91-89398-51788.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.globalcyberassociates.com/): overview of services and positioning.
- [Services](https://www.globalcyberassociates.com/solutions): VAPT, compliance audits (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR), SOC operations & 24/7 monitoring, corporate security training — with pricing.
- [About](https://www.globalcyberassociates.com/about): company background.
- [VisuN AI](https://www.globalcyberassociates.com/products/visunai): workforce visibility, productivity intelligence, and insider-threat monitoring product.
- [Products](https://www.globalcyberassociates.com/products): full product lineup.
- [Free risk assessment](https://www.globalcyberassociates.com/assessment): request a cybersecurity risk assessment.
- [Contact](https://www.globalcyberassociates.com/contact): get in touch.
- [Careers](https://www.globalcyberassociates.com/careers): open roles.
